integrity: Proof is a self-contained reduction to independent arrow-wise linear constraints and graph coloring. Finite scripts corroborate, not replace, the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for finite loopless quivers and radical-square-zero path algebras over finite fields; classical FK identity and zero-fiber specialization are not new. A logically equivalent prior statement could exist; independent audit not performed.
title: Prescribed commutator fibers and chromatic commutator width of radical-square-zero quiver algebras
